title: Nvidia doubles RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell's MSRP to a staggering $16,000 — 96GB card started pre-orders below…
excerpt: A doubling in price from March 2025.
content_html:
Nvidia has once again silently raised the price of its RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell on its US Marketplace website to $16,000. The card was previously listed for $13,250, which itself was a price hike earlier this year since it actually launched at $8,565. Workstation GPUs of this caliber don't really have an MSRP since no one's buying them at retail, but we saw pre-orders for this GPU as low as $7,673 back in March 2025.

  • RTX Pro 6000 at Newegg: $13,998 (Old Price)

Go deeper with TH Premium: GPUs

That's when the card was first announced, and it went on sale a month later, in April 2025, where initial listings had it up for $8,435 for bulk orders and $8,565 for single-unit purchases. This means the June 2026 change from $8,435 to $13,250 was already a 57% price increase, and now, from $13,250 to $16,000, we're seeing a roughly 20% hike. In total, from March 2025 to August 2026, the RTX Pro 6000 became almost 90% more expensive.

If you count the pre-order prices that were momentarily below $8,000 — we're seeing this card sell for more than twice what it debuted at. Keep in mind that we're talking about the boxed Workstation Edition, which is basically like the Founder's Edition for these professional cards, because otherwise it's also available in a 300W Max-Q variant with a blower-style cooler, and a server edition with passive cooling for rack mounts.

These price hikes were not officially confirmed by Nvidia at any point during 2025 and 2026. With the ongoing component crisis continuing to worsen memory prices, these changes are not a surprise, especially when you consider the RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell has 96GB of GDDR7 VRAM.

Still, a nearly $7,500 increase from March 2025 listings to now is a sizeable jump. For what it's worth, we found the same SKU listed on Newegg for $13,998, so $2,000 less than Nvidia's official store and basically the same price as before. Perhaps this listing will rise to $16,000 the moment current inventory runs out, and prices always vary between retailers. Case in point, B&H has the RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell up for $15,499 right now.

content_html_zh:
Nvidia再次默默地将其美国Marketplace网站上的RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell的价格提高到16,000美元。 该卡之前的上市价格为 13,250 美元，这本身就是今年早些时候的价格上涨，因为它的实际推出价格为 8,565 美元。 这种级别的工作站 GPU 并没有真正的建议零售价，因为没有人在零售店购买它们，但我们在 2025 年 3 月看到这款 GPU 的预订单低至 7,673 美元。

  • Newegg 上的 RTX Pro 6000：13,998 美元（旧价）

深入了解 TH Premium：GPU

当时该卡首次发布，一个月后即 2025 年 4 月开始销售，最初的上市价格为批量订单 8,435 美元，单件购买价格为 8,565 美元。 这意味着 2026 年 6 月从 8,435 美元到 13,250 美元的价格上涨已经是 57%，而现在，从 13,250 美元到 16,000 美元，我们看到价格上涨了大约 20%。 总的来说，从 2025 年 3 月到 2026 年 8 月，RTX Pro 6000 的价格上涨了近 90%。

如果算上暂时低于 8,000 美元的预购价格，我们会发现这张卡的售价是其首次亮相时的两倍多。 请记住，我们谈论的是盒装工作站版，它基本上类似于这些专业卡的创始人版，因为除此之外，它还提供带有鼓风式冷却器的 300W Max-Q 变体，以及带有用于机架安装的被动冷却的服务器版本。

Nvidia 在 2025 年和 2026 年期间的任何时候都没有正式确认这些价格上涨。 随着持续的组件危机继续恶化内存价格，这些变化并不令人意外，特别是当您考虑到 RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell 拥有 96GB GDDR7 VRAM 时。

尽管如此，从 2025 年 3 月挂牌到现在的价格上涨了近 7,500 美元，这是一个相当大的跳跃。 就其价值而言，我们发现该 SKU 在 Newegg 上的售价为 13,998 美元，比 Nvidia 官方商店便宜了 2,000 美元，价格与之前基本相同。 也许当当前库存耗尽时，该清单的价格将上涨至 16,000 美元，而且零售商之间的价格总是有所不同。 举个例子，B&H 的 RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell 现在售价 15,499 美元。
